info.title: Athletic Standard host API
info.summary: Read and write Athletic Standard records on an ath-host, within the athlete's grants.
info.description: Generated from the Rust definitions in `host/src/operations.rs` and `host/src/shapes.rs` (D266). Do not edit by hand. The guide for this API is `docs/hosting.md` section 7. Every error answer is JSON with a stable code (`Error`). Records and revisions use the published package schemas of the record format version the host reports in `/v1/capabilities`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 1 to 200 characters. Send the same key when you repeat a request. A repeat with the same key, method, path, and body gets the first answer; the same key with another request gets `409 request_conflict` (D261).

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: 1 to 200 characters. Send the same key when you repeat a request. A repeat with the same key, method, path, and body gets the first answer; the same key with another request gets `409 request_conflict` (D261).

Error400.description: `invalid`: the request is malformed, or a body does not match its shape.

Error401.description: `sign_in_required`: no token, or a token the host refuses. The answer has a `WWW-Authenticate` header naming the protected-resource metadata.

Error403.description: `permission_denied`: the route or permission is not the caller's. `app_disconnected`: the owner disconnected this app from the record.

Error404.description: `not_found`: no such resource, or nothing the caller may see. An unknown record and one that is not shared get the same answer.

Error413.description: `limit_reached`: the body is larger than the host allows.

Error500.description: `internal`: the host could not finish. Details stay in the host's log.

bearer.description: An OAuth access token from the host's OpenID Connect provider (D260). The token must name the app it was issued to in `azp` or `client_id`. `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` names the provider.
